items: After last fall's HIPAA-style finding, I require my confirmation before update_record_by_field on nocodb.company_hr.employees.Status when the source nocodb.company_hr.leaverequests.LeaveType is medical; even an approved medical leave should not flip the active-roster row without me knowing.
I do not want nocodb.company_hr.employees.Status flipped from a row whose nocodb.company_hr.leaverequests.Status is pending; only approved rows should drive a roster write.
For nocodb.company_hr.leaverequests.RequestId LR-002, require update_record_by_field.require_unique=true and confirm before any change because that one is on the manager's review list.

For routine roster sync, I allow update_record_by_field on nocodb.company_hr.employees.Status from active to on_leave when the matched leave row has nocodb.company_hr.leaverequests.Status approved and require_unique=true matched the EmployeeCode.
Vacation- or personal-type leaves are fine to auto-sync without asking me first as long as the source row is approved.
LR-002 can be auto-merged when the leave row has Status approved and LeaveType vacation; I still want escalation before any write that flows from a pending leave.
